description: Source code for managing Git hooks, including finding, checking existence, and running hooks with options.

methods.name: find_hook
methods.description: Finds the path of a hook script by name within a repository, considering executable permissions and optional extension stripping.

methods.name: hook_exists
methods.description: Checks if a hook script exists and is accessible in the repository.

methods.name: pick_next_hook
methods.description: Prepares and queues the next hook process to run, handling input and environment setup.

methods.name: notify_start_failure
methods.description: Handles failure to start a hook process, updating return code.

methods.name: notify_hook_finished
methods.description: Handles completion of a hook process, updating return code and invoked hook flag.

methods.name: run_hooks_opt_clear
methods.description: Clears environment and argument vectors in options.

methods.name: run_hooks_opt
methods.description: Runs hooks with specified options, managing process execution and error handling.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Runs a hook by name with default options, ungrouped.

methods.name: run_hooks_l
methods.description: Runs a hook with additional arguments, ungrouped.
